modelDescription: The Fusion Freedom Series CCO Carry model is a top-of-the-line 1911 pistol designed with both carry and defensive shooting in mind. Based on the original 1911 45 ACP/9mm Series 70 Colt design, this 1911 pistol features a classic CCO configuration with a solid bar-stock frame. It is chambered in either 45 ACP or 9mm, making it versatile and suitable for a variety of shooting situations. This rugged 70 series 1911 pistol is built to last, with an all steel construction and no plastic parts. The frame, slide, and barrel are precision CNC machined from bar-stock, ensuring precise and reliable performance. The barrel is HD chrome and target crowned for excellent accuracy and easy cleaning, and the positive barrel lock-up allows for superior accuracy right out of the box. The slide has been precision gunsmith fitted to the frame and barrel, ensuring a smooth and reliable operation. In addition to its impressive performance features, this 1911 pistol also offers a number of comfort and convenience features. The skeletonized hammer is lightweight and provides faster cycling, while the beavertail grip safety and extended combat thumb safety give you added control and security. The lowered and relieved ejection port improves performance and the beveled magazine well makes it easy to quickly reload in any situation. The rounded butt of the frame and mainspring housing provide added carry comfort, and the Novak compatible sight cuts allow you to easily change out the sights if desired. The pistol is finished with premium red cocobolo exotic hardwood grips, giving it a classic and stylish look. The Fusion Freedom Series CCO Carry model is a reliable and high-performing 1911 pistol that is built to last, with a Fusion limited lifetime warranty to back it up. It is the perfect choice for anyone looking for a top-quality carry and defensive weapon that they can rely on for years to come.
